messages:
Eve (Support): heads-up — multiple hosted-api customers reporting 502/504 and gateway timeouts hitting eu-central-1a this morning, started ~08:22 UTC. Support ticket volume spiking. throwing this into incidents channel to triage.

Samir (Infra): seen an alert from edge-monitor-bot too. p95 latency up ~4x for inference routes in eu-central-1, and a lot of upstream 502s from the api-gateway. any repro steps yet?

Eve (Support): reproduced by curling the public endpoint for a small customer: `curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer **REDACTED**' -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'` -> intermittent 502 / sometimes 504 after 10s. snippets: 

```
* TCP connection ok
> POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
* Connection #0 to host api.redwood.ai left intact
```

Linh (SRE): pulled mtr from edge to inference cluster in eu-central-1a. saw sustained packet loss at hop 6/7 that corresponds to TransitCorp provider footprint. paste: 

```
Start: 2026-03-15 08:30:13
HOST: edge-01.redwood.net

domain: 10.0.0.0
Packets: 100
1. 10.0.0.1 0.0% 0.0% 0.0%
2. 192.168.1.1 0.0% 0.0% 0.0%
3. 203.0.113.5 12.0% 10.5% 11.2%  << transit egress
4. 198.51.100.9 30.0% 28.4% 29.1% << heavy loss
5. 172.16.0.5 0.0% 0.0% 0.0% (intra-az)
```

Maya (NetOps): confirmed the AS path shows a recent route churn for TransitCorp -> CarrierX peering in eu-central-1 region. BGP updates spike at ~08:20 UTC. I can open a ticket with CarrierX, but we should also plan an immediate mitigation.

Jordan (Platform): impact matrix? which customers and which routes? need quick rollback plan if we must reroute.

Eve (Support): top impacted customers: 3 medium SaaS, 1 high (plaid-like fintech trial) — they're seeing request failure rates ~15-40% for that AZ. Most traffic is through the eu-central-1 LB -> api-gateway -> inference pool (eu-central-1a primary).

Samir (Infra): quick mitigation options: 
- fail traffic off eu-central-1a to eu-central-1b/c within region (zone failover) 
- route read traffic to eu-west-1 for critical customers (regional failover) 
- bump proxy retries / extend gateway timeouts temporarily (not ideal for correctness)

Linh (SRE): zone failover requires updating the traffic-router policy for the customer routes — I can push a canary to 5% immediately, then scale to 50% if stable.

Maya (NetOps): +1 to canary plus external ticket. I'll open the CarrierX ticket and ask for expedited escalation. their NOC is already seeing flaps per their status page.

edge-monitor-bot: [08:33:02] detected increased packet loss on path eu-central-1a -> inference-pool-03 (loss > 20% over 60s)

netops-bot: [08:34:05] BGP update storm detected: Peer=CarrierX, AS_PATH changed 120 times in last 10m

Jordan (Platform): runbook step: if canary shows <3% error on new AZ after 10m, we scale to 100% and mark incident as mitigated. if not, escalate to cross-region failover and inform billing/CS to align SLA messaging.

Eve (Support): starting canary now for the highest impact customer (customer-id: cus_9b2f). will report results in 10m. pinging Samir to watch the gateway logs for 502->upstream connection errors. @Samir (Infra)

Samir (Infra): watching logs. initial canary 5% routed to eu-central-1b. logs show fewer upstream timeouts there. copying relevant error lines: 

```
[2026-03-15T08:36:12Z] gateway.go:421 Upstream error: dial tcp 10.2.14.22:443: i/o timeout
[2026-03-15T08:36:13Z] gateway.go:421 Upstream error: read tcp 10.2.14.22:443: connection reset by peer
[2026-03-15T08:36:40Z] gateway.go:421 Upstream success: 200 (latency 320ms)
```

Linh (SRE): canary looks promising — error rate for the canary customer dropped from 22% -> 1.8% in the first 6m. I'm going to increase canary to 35% now.

Maya (NetOps): CarrierX NOC replied: "we see elevated packet loss on a subset of links in FRA region, working on mitigation. ETA unknown". they asked for traceroute from our ASN. I've shared MTR output.

Jordan (Platform): next steps while we wait on CarrierX: 
1) complete regional failover if canary stays good (Samir/Linh) 
2) update status page + CS messaging (Eve) 
3) continue pressure on CarrierX (Maya) 
4) consider permanent routing preference change for affected customers to avoid that transit in future (post-incident)

Eve (Support): updating status page now: "Degraded performance and 5xx errors for hosted inference in eu-central-1a due to upstream transit provider packet loss. We're routing traffic across healthy AZs; mitigation in progress." adding follow-ups for billing/credits if SLA hit.

Samir (Infra): increased canary to 80% — monitoring. gateway 502s decreasing overall. preparing an automated rollback hook if errors spike >5% for 3m.

edge-monitor-bot: [08:43:18] p95 latency for inference routes in eu-central-1 now down to 420ms from 1.6s baseline. 5xx rate trending down.

Maya (NetOps): CarrierX updated: "Temporary reroute applied on our edge; we see packet loss drop to <2% now." continue to monitor for recurrence.

Linh (SRE): holding at 100% traffic to eu-central-1b/c. error rates back to baseline for affected customers. Will keep this incident open as 'monitoring' until 2h of stable metrics.

Jordan (Platform): postmortem action items captured: 
- add automated routing preference to avoid high-loss transit if packet loss >X for >Ym (NetOps)
- expand canary automation to region-wide scripted cutover (Platform)
- update runbooks to include immediate CarrierX contact flow (CS/NetOps)
- evaluate multi-transit for eu-central region (Infra/NetOps)

Eve (Support): note for customer comms: emphasize mitigation performed (AZ failover), root cause under investigation with CarrierX, offering proactive RCA and SLA review.

Samir (Infra): assigning owners in PagerDuty for RCA and long-term fixes. will post RCA draft in #postmortems within 48h.

Eve (Support): thanks all — looks like mitigated for now. I'll follow up with customers and close support tickets as degraded->resolved once we hit the 2h stable window. :white_check_mark:

Maya (NetOps): keeping CarrierX ticket open until they confirm full fix. will update here.

Linh (SRE): leaving monitoring alarms at higher sensitivity for 6h.

netops-bot: [08:47:05] Incident state: MITIGATED -> MONITORING (owner=Maya (NetOps))
